why: `wave/muster` fields two kinds of body — the named Muster Hands and a Muster Stray — so no one entry's name is the name of the whole fight, and with its `title` removed the bar has nothing to draw. The engine owns no English that is right for a porter, a bell-ringer and a choir at once, so it refuses rather than inventing one. The build names the wave, says it has two mob entries, and prescribes stating `title` or naming the body. It declares no unit: the derived title is bound by `wave/lane`, whose one entry's name titles its bar, and the stated title by the primary's own `wave/muster`.
